 Johnny Depp hosts private ‘Ebenezer’ screening, Teyana Taylor throws VIP party and more sightings 
 By 
 Leah Bitsky 
 Published 
 Nov. 3, 2026, 3:47 p.m. ET 
 See more of our coverage in your search results. 
 Make Page Six a Preferred Source 
 Johnny Depp kicked off the global release of “Ebenezer”  in New York City with an invite-only special screening at The Whitby Hotel on Sunday night, a source told Page Six.
 The screening drew a mix of talent from film, television and music, including co-stars Andrea Riseborough and Tramell Tillman, director Ti West, Hayley Atwell, Britt Lower, Kyle MacLachlan, Patti Smith, Shaboozey, Depeche Mode’s Dave Gahan and influencer Matt Friend.
 The next day, we’re told Depp surprised crowds at Bryant Park’s Christmas Market, taking over the holiday scene in character as Ebenezer Scrooge.
 8

 8 
 Depp surprised guests by dressing as Ebenezer Scrooge at Bryan Park’s Winter Village the day after the screening (seen above). Getty Images for Paramount Pictures

 “Hundreds of fans quickly gathered around,” a source told us, adding that social media videos quickly circulated online. 
 The film hits theaters on Nov.13. 
 On Saturday night, Teyana Taylor celebrated Halloween with a star-studded party at Beauty & Essex.
 The haunted motel-themed fête featured guests including La La Anthony, Becky G, and Busta Rhymes, Saweetie, Karl-Anthony Towns and Jordyn Woods, a spy told Page Six.
 Others in attendance included Ceyair Wright, Daniel Kaluuya, Nas’ daughter Destiny Jones, Joe Budden, Joey Bada$$, LaQuan Smith and Savannah James. 
 Last Thursday at Lincoln Center’s Vivian Beaumont Theater, Tom Hanks and Rita Wilson, Anna Wintour, Rachel Zegler and Adam Scott were among the stars who turned out for the opening night of “A Few Good Men.” 
 8 
 Tom Blyth and Demi Moore posed for photos at the “A Few Good Men” opening night on Nov. 1. WireImage 
 8 
 Katie Holmes and Jason Bard Yarmosky spent date night at the American Ballet Theatre Fall Gala on Oct. 29 (seen above). GC Images 
 The star-studded crowd celebrated the first-ever Broadway revival of Aaron Sorkin’s acclaimed play alongside cast members Tom Blyth, Krysta Rodriguez and Bradley Whitford, as well as Sorkin and director Michael Arden.
 Other guests included Demi Moore, David Corenswet, Betty Gilpin, Wendell Pierce, Kate Walsh and Jeremy Jordan. 
 A stone’s throw away at David H. Koch Theater, Cynthia Erivo was honored at the American Ballet Theatre’s Fall Gala.
 Katie Holmes and her boyfriend, Jason Bard Yarmosky , were there as well as Debbie Allen, Nicky Hilton, Elizabeth Sulcer and Bronx Banco founder, Natalie De’Banco. 
 We’re told De’Banco dressed both Hilton and Sulcer in her brand’s latest Fall collection for the event.
 The previous evening, Lin-Manuel Miranda was honored at the City Center Annual Gala production of “In the Heights” at Ziegfeld Ballroom. 
 Other guests of honor for the evening included Quiara Alegria Hudes, Mark Kingdon and Anla Cheng Kingdon.
 Last Tuesday, Gayle King, Diane Von Furstenberg, and Mike Bloomberg were seen at the PAC NYC Icons of Culture Gala, where Bob Iger was honored. 
 The night before, Sara Moonves, Sofia Coppola, and Ava Nirui hosted an intimate dinner with Park Hyatt at Thai Diner to celebrate WYouth, the recently launched sister publication of W Magazine. 
 8 
 Sara Moonves, Ava Nirui and Sofia Coppola were seen at the WYouth launch at Thai Diner on Oct. 26 (seen above). Getty Images for W Magazine

 Other notable faces in the room included Emily Ratajkowski, Gracie Abrams, Jordan Firstman, ADÉLA, Benito Skinner, Jack Antonoff, Olivia Jade, Apple Martin, and Jake Shane.
 We hear guests enjoyed a culinary menu curated by the hotspot and took home special gift bags as they left the evening.
 “Gilded Age” stars Morgan Spector, Carrie Coon, Louisa Jacobson, Cynthia Nixon, Denée Benton, Taissa Farmiga and Harry Richardson walked the red carpet at the Season 4 premiere in Midtown that night.
 We hear Coon and Jacobson attended the ritzy after-party held at The Plaza.
 8 
 The cast of “Gilded Age” celebrated their Season 4 premiere at The Plaza on Oct. 26 (seen above). Matthew Rettenmund / SplashNews.com 
 8 
 Jim Morrison was seen with director Jimmy Chin at the premiere of “Everest: The Other Side” on Oct. 30 (seen above). Getty Images for Disney 
 That same night, elite mountaineer Jim Morrison celebrated the premiere of his National Geographic documentary, “Everest: The Other Side,” 100 stories above Manhattan at the new Avenue Sky at Edge, alongside Oscar-winning directors Elizabeth Chai Vasarhelyi and Jimmy Chin. 
 Ben Stiller, Drew Barrymore, Frances McDormand, Chris Meloni, Chelsea Clinton and Susie Essman were some of the stars in the crowd at the screening hosted by The North Face and Cinema Society.
 The film chronicles Morrison’s historic feat of becoming the first person to ski down Mount Everest’s rarely summited North Face.
